_note: Background music (src/audio/music.gd). states: which track plays when (menu = title, lobby and after a defeat; explore = a quiet room; combat = a fight with enemies alive or a horde still coming; boss = a boss or mini-boss alive). track names a music entry of audio_library.json; volume_db trims it on top of its gain_db; ambience true lays the ambience track under it on the Ambience bus. crossfade: seconds between two tracks; calm_hold: seconds a fight must be over before the music calms down again (no flip-flopping between waves). Change the choices in the Klangwerkstatt (debug menu) or here.
